comment: Strategic precisions (NVFP4 + FP8 KV) on Mistral-Small-3.2-NVFP4 (24B). Q8_0 GGUF as legacy reference.

mistral_small_32_nvfp4.path: NVFP4 weights + FP8 prefill auto + FP16 KV + NVFP4 decode mode 2

mistral_small_32_fp8_kv.path: NVFP4 weights + FP8 prefill + FP8 E4M3 KV + FP8 FMHA

qwen3_8b_q8_0_legacy.path: Q8 weights + FP8 prefill auto + NVFP4 decode auto + FP16 KV
qwen3_8b_q8_0_legacy.note: pp delta is within memory-documented cuBLAS autotuning variance (up to 2.6x). tg delta is real-and-unexplained-this-bringup; legacy GGUF path, not a strategic priority. Could be a regression from one of ~50 commits since 2026-03-27, or a baseline-conditions drift. Phase-7 spec only requires regression tracking on NVFP4 + FP8.

regressions_in_strategic_paths: none — NVFP4 and FP8 KV are new baselines (no prior measurement)
